content.text:
Yes, this is really common at 20 months. Sleep regressions, teething, and big leaps in language and independence often trigger new night wakings around now.

Tonight, keep it boring. If they wake, go in, keep the lights off, say a short calm line like "it's sleep time, I'm here," and settle them in the crib without picking them up or starting a game. Doing it the same way every night helps them learn to resettle on their own.
